usage.callShape: POST https://x402-ai-api.civicmerge.workers.dev/v1/audio/transcribe with JSON body {file: <audio>} (x402 USDC on Base, $0.020). NOTE: backend 500s on every JSON encoding tried.
usage.outputShape: Declared output: body.text (e.g. {"text":"Hello, world."}). NOT OBSERVED — server returned 500 plain-text "Internal Server Error" instead.
quirks: Backend is broken: pays then returns HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error' (text/plain). Charge-then-fail — payment settles but no transcription is returned.

inputSchema says 'file' is multipart form-data binary, but the live bazaar metadata declares bodyType=json with body {file: '<binary audio data>'} and output example {text: 'Hello, world.'} — contradictory.
Tried file as raw base64 string AND as data:audio/wav;base64 data-URL in a JSON body; both 500'd.

Untested: true multipart/form-data file upload (qa-pay only sends application/json, so the multipart path could not be exercised). The 500 may be specific to JSON; a multipart client might behave differently but was not verifiable here.
Spent $0.04 total across 2 paid attempts, both 500.
usage.guide: This speech-to-text endpoint is currently broken via JSON: it accepts the x402 payment ($0.020 USDC on Base) and then returns HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error' with no transcription. Two JSON encodings of the audio (raw base64 and base64 data-URL in a {file:...} body) were paid for and both 500'd. The declared success shape is {"text": "..."} read from body.text, but it was never observed. A fresh agent should treat this as broken; if attempting, the only untried path is a real multipart/form-data file upload (the schema's stated format), but expect to lose money given the consistent 500s.
